guidebook.intro: East Africa has Africa’s highest mountain, its biggest lake and the source of the Nile. Here are the words for its landscapes.

tips.title: Trees and rivers: m- and mi-
body: Many nature words are in the **m-/mi-** class: **mti/miti** (tree), **mto/mito** (river), **mlima/milima** (mountain), **msitu/misitu** (forest). Their words agree with **u-** and **i-**: **mto unaanzia** (the river starts), **miti mingi** (many trees).
This is different from people (**m-/wa-**): **mtu mrefu, watu warefu**, but **mti mrefu, miti mirefu**.

culture.title: Green Belt
body: Kenya’s Wangari Maathai started the Green Belt Movement, in which women have planted tens of millions of trees. She won the Nobel Peace Prize in 2004. Tree planting days are common in schools.
